To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the magnitude and distribution of transactions costs and the level of financial resources determine whether a farmer will be risk averse or risk preferring.
the magnitudes of transactions costs are important determinants of the decision-maker's behavior.
financial transactions costs can lead to risk aversion, risk preference, or risk neutrality, depending on the individual's initial wealth and the distribution of random outcomes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the implications of financial constraints and transactions for the risk behavior of farmers.
the effects of financial transactions costs and constraints on the behavior of farmers.
the effects of transactions costs, financial constraints, and policy instruments on risk behavior of farm households.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the model results are consistent with a wide array of observed risk behavior in agriculture.
the presence of risk and the presence of transactions costs are sufficient to explain risk behavior.
risk behavior is complex and that the model presented in this study is a step toward understanding the complexity of risk behavior.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
risk aversion is more common in our model when financial constraints are tight, the magnitude of risk is large, and the underlying distribution is skewed to the right.
risk aversion is not the only possible outcome of a risk averse individual facing a risky decision in the presence of transactions costs.
financial transactions costs can be a very important determinant of behavior.
The main takeaway from our work is that
risk behavior can be understood by accounting for financial transactions constraints and costs.
financial constraints and transactions cost are likely to have a significant impact on risk behavior.
financial transactions costs and the financial position of the decision maker can explain the observed risk behavior in a way that is consistent with the notion of risk aversion.
